reviews.text:
Must pay to use without info on $. I love the games where there is motivation to buy your pet something or decorate. Like the apps Finch or Bitepal. However these games have a free version and premium add on features. I chose to use these apps because I got to check them out without premium features and see if this app works for me.

 When I got this app I immediately had to do a free trail and I could not see how much the actually cost was. Bitepal does the first year premium $2.99 a month while this app charges that a week. It seems like there is also a $5.99 per month option too.

Guidance with features. I am loving the app, the capybara is adorable. I am having trouble figuring out how to progress to the Amazon fish season even though I have finished with the Atlantic. As well I have not been able to figure out the bing chilling and bonjoir achievements. I contact support and no one responds back.

reviews.text: Very great app. I am using this app with my young daughter for health reasons.This is the only app I’ve found that appropriately calculates an intake for a person her age. (Others calculate unsustainable/unhealthy levels because they are for adults) the only comments I have is that food logging is a little clunky if you are trying to log something a day later it tends to auto add it to the current day, I wish you could edit the date in the “edit entry” section. I also wish more of the food selections could be broken down into gram servings instead of just whole packaged servings

reviews.text: So much fun. I lost 8 pounds in 16 weeks
Took my money. Took my money without notifying me and I’ve contacted multiple times for a refund but they never responded. Do not recommend this app.

Paid app, not free. You can download this app for free, but to actually use it you need to pay for it. It asks you to put in your info (height weight any goals) but that’s as much interaction you get. Then you’re taken to page where you can try to app for $0 but of course that means agreeing to one of the subscription options.
Disappointing. I used this app in the past and it was free and now it’s a subscription that you don’t find out about til after you sign up.

Adorable Calorie Counter. I have already seen progress after a short amount of time using this app. It's so great and really convenient to use! My only wish is that it had better furniture /decor options. It feels like they haven't really given much care or thought to that part of the app, which to me was the selling point. I use the Finch app and it has furniture /clothes for every place you visit and depending on the month. There's a new theme every month and it's super cute! I wish this app had more features like that.

DO NOT PURCHASE. I purchased this app and realized it wasn’t doing what I thought it would. I contacted Support to see if I can get a refund as I only had it for less than a day. No response back no support whatsoever. So I tried to work with the app and use it and was still having issues with it. It wouldn’t save my foods or it would over calculate certain meals. contacted support again and still no response.

Not cool. Cute design. Liked the friendly feeling interface.
However, two big NOs from me. First is during the initial setup asking for a review. I haven't even gotten to the actual app!
Second, nowhere in the description did I see that a subscription is required to use the app at all. 
Deleted
Can’t proceed without paying. They don’t break the news to you that you have to pay to use the app until after you’ve named your capybara that broke my heart

Super fun!. This has so many helpful functions! I love how it graphs your progress and offers nutritional ideas for your next meal. I also like how you can turn your progress into cute items for the capybara in the shop! Absolutely great app!
Ok. I know this app woud be good if it did not cost munny
Wanted to love it. App is so hard to use, not user friendly at all!

reviews.text: Love this app!. This app is super cute and helps with maintaining a healthy overall lifestyle. Absolutely recommend!
Pay to use ANY feature. Typically apps have some free features, but not this one.

Almost a year in. The app does some things great. I like the tracking. But one of my motivations is being able to purchase things for my Capy. It’s been well over a month and there is nothing in the shop to shop for! Please refill the shop!!!!! Also, when there is a story to read, parts of the story get cut off and I’m unable to scroll to read the full script. I’m on an iPhone. I’d also like to be able to see a progress chart that covers a longer time period.

reviews.text: Forced to subscribe. I just downloaded the app and when i was filling my information they asked me to review the app (how? i haven’t used it yet to have an opinion) then to actually use the app they made me subscribe. there was no “X” button and no way to not subscribe. this is a very bad dark pattern, if you expect all users to pay then make the app payed, do not make it “free” and then force them to pay after they already downloaded it. I accepted the 7 days free trial to check but the app was lacking, felt very incomplete and it was just very boring. i will not be using the app and do not recommend to other people.
Good app but.... This app really helped me and its really cool to use but it’s just some times I get confused but overall best app to lose weight or gain some more weight

Cute and useful app!. Thank you to the developers! This app is very colorful and fun to use. Food, exercise and water is easy to log. The decor is very cute and it is motivating to do the activities and earn the gems and leaves. 

I wish there was a way to make notes on each day. And I wish we could log and get gems and leaves for other things besides diet, Activity and water. For example: logging hours of sleep, meditation or relaxation, taking medications, or a spot to add in our own goals that are important to us to track each day.

Hmm. I used this app before and I loved it but now when I log on to the app it’s prompting me to become a premium member. I can’t afford premium. Is there no way I could use it for free ? Or do I have to pay for premium?
Wish I could save meals. I love this app, but I wish there was a way to save meals so I didn’t have to add every single ingredient everytime!

Super cute and helpful. I love this app because first off, it’s so cute! I hate the very boring fitness app that feel so serious and intimidating. This app actually makes weight loss and fitness and nutrition really fun! I like that you can earn points to “buy” and decorate your own little house. I do wish I could add more to my Capys home and there were a bit more cutesy, cozy things to purchase. I love that the app is extremely positive and suggestive and helpful! It makes me look forward to logging my progress. I’ve already lost ELEVEN POUNDS!!! 🎉🙌🥳

No Free Option. This is on me for not reading the description, but for everyone that reads the reviews first there is no free version of this app. 

They do offer a free trial if you are interested in paying later down the line.
Scam. I clicked on the 7 day free trial option, and was charged for a full year. I have contacted support 3 separate times and they have not yet gotten back to me.
Money grabber. Can’t even use any part of the app without paying for a subscription. Cant even fully open and try the app without paying for a subscription.

i love capydiet. i have tried at least 10 calorie tracking apps and nothing comes close to capy diet. the logging process is simple, and they offer features like ai scan and barcode scan for free, something that so many apps don’t have for free. they also don’t bombard you with pop ups telling you to get the pro version. there’s also like um the cute parts where you like go mining or fishing or something (i don’t use it that often) but it’s there if you need any other motivation. it’s also so clean and easy to use and i love my capybara he’s so cute. yah this is like a t1 app of all time

Friendly, guilt free app. I love this app so much. I’m a BIG guy and have been trying to lose weight for years, and in those years I was diagnosed with bulimia with atypical anorexic obsessive calorie counting. This app does not guilt you, it encourages you, gives you advice without making you feel bad. I’ve only been using it for a few days, and it has helped me drastically. Plus it’s so cute, I mean, it’s a capybara. Who doesn’t love capybaras? Def recommend, especially for those struggling with EDs.

Awesome app!. Such an awesome app, it’s super cute and interactive! Only downside is some of the advice and meal plan suggestions are not very sustainable or healthy to do, so I would suggest to take all of those with a grain of salt! Some of the meal plan suggestions are like 1500 calories a day, which is definitely way too little.

Adorable. How can anyone not love the idea of a capybara nutrition coach? Especially when your positive habits allow you to dress it up in cute outfits. I find the calorie/nutrition tracking aspect to be accurate, and the AI coaching to be really supportive and helpful. Such a fun change from all the other boring nutrition apps.
not usable unless you pay. literally can’t use any of the features unless i do the 7 day free trial im not paying for this i fear

No free option!! U have to pay to use!!!. Once you put in all your information you have to buy a subscription! So annoying!! I thought this idea of an app was super cute and I was excited to use it! Very disappointed.
NOT ACTUALLY FREE. I downloaded this app hopingggg it’ll actually help count my calories, I input everything and then subscription pops up and there’s NO free version, literally got click-baited

U have to pay to use it. it seems fun and cute. i wish apps like this tell you ahead that you’ll have to pay before u can use it. Also there’s no free version so you’re putting in all your info getting excited and you can’t even use it until u pay. 😭
Is not Free. The app is advertised as free with in app purchases, however there isn’t a free version you have to pay to use it.

Requires a subscription.. After entering all my data, out of absolutely nowhere, POOF, a subscription pops up. I understand this review will likely do nothing, but I intend on being as disobedient as possible to the apps that require subscriptions for mundane tasks (I.E caloric tracking.)

no free option. costs money but they don't tell you that until you spend time setting everything up. there's no free option it's just either pay for subscription or don't use the app. why not just make the app paid to start with then? saves us the hassle and you a few bad reviews

Not for me,. Maybe my phone I don’t know, but the only thing I’ve gotten to work after first day is deleting my app. Reinstalled and played a lot with stuff. Just not working. I have no patience with this. Wish I could get a refund.

If you don’t pay you can’t do anything other than start your assessment thing over…

pay only. i wish this was slightly more clear when i first got the app. it does seem like a good calorie counter app but, i think it would be better if a user knew it was pay only before they set up everything else..
No Free version. Downloaded because several reviews mentioned free version. Maybe there used to be. But now it wants $30/year :(

But the only downside so far is that whenever I log in breakfast it doesn’t let me log in my other meals throughout the day. I don’t know if I am missing something but when I log my breakfast in the morning, it won’t let me tap again to log my lunch. Is it because I have to put my meals all in at once? Please help me out so that I can use the app better and it can be beneficial and worth the subscription.

reviews.text: Love it!. Love this app so much! Not only is it helpful and works well, all the commentary is so positive! I’ve used many apps and this the only one I’ve continued to use for more than a week or two! I only wish there was an Apple Watch widget for remaining calories!
Great Weight Loss App. so cute!!! keeps me motivated and coming back to log my foods and activity. i love the positivity and adorable capy graphics

wow.. This app is truly great. If u want a calorie counter, go with this one! Its not just a calorie counter, but a carb, protein, and fats balancer. It doesnt just tell u "eat more proteins" it will say something like "to add more proteins, try this snack." This app has been wonderful. Also the idea of "coach capy" is so hilarious to me. did i mention its completely free?

Mostly good. I’m enjoying the app so far! It’s been a refreshing take on things. It does have you log food and calculates your calories and macros, but the app focuses more on small changes and sustainable habits instead of changing everything at once or being super strict. The one downside I’ve found is the daily weight recording… as a nurse I know that this is not a healthy plan as scale numbers change (or don’t change) for many reasons other than reduced body fat. It would be much healthier to have a weekly weight recording in or an option for weekly body measurements instead.
Did not get 1 week free. Charged me for 1 year. Did not get a free week as advertised!
Can’t use free version. I can’t get past he screen that makes you purchase the app!
Adding calories. Yes, this app is cute. But why does it keep adding calories when I have only had breakfast? In five minutes it added 3 calories. Not cool!

reviews.text: Misleading. I downloaded this app because the ad that saw mentioned a free version with paid upgrades. That is not what I experienced when I downloaded it.
Can’t use app. Can’t use the app without using a free trial. I don’t even have $10 in my account so forgetting to cancel the free trial would be a death sentence. Cute app but please let me use it.
I love the app but…. I wish it had more food options like myfitnesspal. It very hard to log my meals as a person so eats a variety of food
No thanks. Should have been made clear that you have to pay to start
Pay wall. You have to pay before using the app and I do not like that
Jus cute. So cute!!
:). SO CUTE!!!
Paid. Doesn't mention you have to pay for a subscription to even use the app. ☹️

So confused, I feel played. So I saw this app and I read the reviews, they keep mentioning a free version, I cannot find this free version, the app after getting me to give it some information throws up a page for a three day free trial and after that I’d have to pay, maybe they got rid of the free version recently but it doesn’t let me exit the page for the trial and payment without clearing my information.

Helpful and Productive!. This app not only lets you track calories similar to other diet apps, but rewards you for eating each meal by letting you decorate your capybara and unlock stories along the way! I have the free version and it’s still a really enjoyable app with enough functionality for me.
What I truly love about this app are the goals, such as rewarding you for trying new exercises or eating a healthy snack. It’s a very productive get fun app :)

Far outshines other health apps (in my opinion). I’ve used other apps and felt like they were lacking. I found Capy Diet hoping there’d be something I could use that WASN’T N**m. I was super pleasantly surprised, I appreciate that it does feel less focused on weight loss, despite that being my focus. It’s really helping me understand how to actually balance my diet to feel good. I love my little capybara friend too!! His name is Kiwi :-D
LOVE LOVE LOVE. I absolutely ADORE this app. It makes tracking my food fun and makes me actually WANT to track it so I can dress up my lil Capybara bby 💕 10/10

Use of AI. I’ve only just started the app today and I enjoy it for the most part, however the story mode needs work. The background art in the story seems to be made from an AI image generator (most obvious in the panel with animals in the background). I really do hope that in the future they pay some artists to create authentic artwork for the apps story. I know personally I don’t want to financially support companies cost cutting through the use of AI art.

The non stressful dieter. I have tried many different dieting programs + apps and unfortunately many of them promote eating disorder tendencies. 

One thing about this app that many other apps don’t have is that Capy Diet has a feature where it gives you feed back on your current meal choices and how to tweak them. I like how it doesn’t make you completely eliminate the foods you like.

And you don’t NEED to have premium to access the desired features. 

Plus you get to collect coins to feed your little capybara friend. 
I genuinely think this app is awesome, more people should know about it.

Only One Complaint. Love the app as it’s fun, and support is super on top of helping u out. The one complaint is that when I add a recipe I can’t set it to more than one serving. For example, I make lasagne for the week, thus it’s a six serving recipe. I HAVE to figure out either the measurements of each individual ingredient for ONE serving to make a recipe, or the nutritional information for each serving to make a food listing. Need a way to make a HUGE recipe, & then choose how much of that recipe u want to log for the day.
Adorable food log. This app is great and I enjoy using it daily! It makes logging your food easy and cute :)

Don’t believe. I saw an ad about this app and decided to download it before actually reading the review. It’s cool but the only way to have more features is to pay 30 bucks which is pretty expensive… I fall for the free advertising and now idk if I should keep this or not:(
CapyDiet keeps changing my new weight!. I love capy diet but it keeps reverting my new weight to my starting weight. It’s very frustrating that it won’t keep my new weight!

reviews.text: Love love love. This is my favorite app in the entire world. From the fun games, the goals you have to eat and also just how cute everything is. Top 10/10

Give it a try. This app is beyond adorable. There are different things to do in the app besides add food, so it gives me a reason to keep coming back. It’s low pressure as well. I will say that the database is not vast so many of the foods I wanted to add didn’t show up when scanned or search. I had to input that myself. It’s an indie developer so I can work with it.

reviews.text: Looking forward to more features. I’m currently using the free version and it’s got the best database for an app of its style. I love the cutesy, cartoony style of Chinese diet tracking apps while maintaining utility. And this is the closest I’ve seen in English. So I will definitely continue to use it. However, I would love to see the ability to push and pull data from Apple (or other OS) health data. I have other apps with overlapping features, so it’d be nice to see a way for the data of one to push to Apple and then be pulled from Apple by CapyDiet. I understand there may be room for discrepancies, but I would rather deal with that than the bouncing between apps manually. Because I struggle enough with staying motivated to track these things. It’d be nice to have some added convenience. Love the app nonetheless ❤️
i can’t find the farm. i love this game but since the update i can’t find the farm now

reviews.text: Overall, adorable, but…. I really wish there was a way that you can add food that there’s no barcode scan for and I wish it was a little easier to adjust serving sizes. The app is self is adorable though.

Amazing!!!!!. Wow this is exactly what I was looking for in a calorie counting app and I am soo happy I discovered Capy! It’s fun and engaging, I was bored with the other apps until I found this. Also it’s SO CUTE everything about it. I love it!
Great Wellness App. Would love to have some way to connect to my Apple Watch. And also a widget!
Great app to keep track your diet. Great app to keep track of the food, exercises and sport you do! Enjoy using it

miss the old version. I love this app however the new update implemented today is disappointing in my opinion, the previous version was cuter and there was more to do with the capybara. Either way a great app.

reviews.text: Great app to keep fit. My must go to app to log daily calories, super cute pet to light up your mood!

Make Weight Loss Fun & Easy. This is the cutest weight loss app I've ever downloaded!!! The graphics are simple and fun, the features/functions are with lots of options for weight loss, weight gain, and whatever you need, which suits most people. The most eye-catching thing is the super cute guinea pig pet, which makes weight loss easy and fun.
Fun game. Play a fun game while keeping track of my diet! Loving it!
Idea!. CAN YOU MAKE IT A WIDGET PLEASE!!!!!

Get your capybara!. Mark your diet records can be boring and hard to keep up, but what if you have a cute capy to take care of? This whole new idea of making an avatar of yourself and keep “feeding” him/her works like a clock, when you eat/drink something, you’ll remember to take care of the capy as well. For the app itself, simple and cute interface, easy to use and manage. Keep up to a good diet record with the Capy!

Super fun and helps meet my diet goal. I absolutely love Capy! It's clear that the developers put their heart into creating this app, as the UI and animations are incredibly cute and lively. Logging items and tracking progress is a breeze, making it easy to stay on top of my diet goals. The game aspect of the app adds a fun and rewarding twist to the experience. Plus, the widget is a great addition, helping me stay motivated with progress reminders. Highly recommend!
Cute lifestyle app!. Fantastic calorie counter! Makes managing my diet so much easier and the capybara theme is adorable.
One of the best calories tracking app!. A very engaging calories tacking app! I barely forget logging any meal just to keep capy happy. The capy games are very fun and not too time consuming.

A Game-Changer for Healthy Living!. As someone constantly striving for a healthier lifestyle, I've tried countless diet apps, but none have impressed me as much as CapyDiet. This app is an absolute game-changer! From its user-friendly interface to its comprehensive database of recipes and meal plans, CapyDiet has exceeded all my expectations.

One of the standout features is its personalized approach to meal planning. By considering my dietary preferences, restrictions, and goals, CapyDiet generates tailored meal plans that make sticking to a healthy diet effortless. The recipes are not only delicious but also simple to follow, making cooking enjoyable even for someone with limited culinary skills like myself.

The tracking feature is another highlight, allowing me to monitor my progress with ease. Whether it's tracking my daily calorie intake, water consumption, or exercise routine, CapyDiet keeps me accountable and motivated to stay on track towards my health goals.

Overall, I can't recommend CapyDiet enough to anyone looking to adopt a healthier lifestyle. It's not just a diet app, it's a comprehensive wellness tool that has transformed the way I approach nutrition and fitness. Give it a try you won't be disappointed!

Fashion Meets Fitness. Never thought I'd be this excited to dress up a virtual pet for my fitness journey, but here we are, absolutely loving every bit of CapyDiet! The variety of cute outfits you can unlock for Capy not only adds a fun, personalized touch but also serves as a brilliant incentive to stay on track with my health goals. Each new outfit represents milestones in my journey, making every achievement feel special. Beyond the adorable aesthetics, CapyDiet has a lot of informative nutrition articles that have educated me on making better food choices. The blend of learning and fun has transformed my approach to wellness, making CapyDiet an important part of my daily routine. A big shoutout to the developers！

Amazing app - Losing weight is actually fun now. I am 28 years old and have a long struggle with my weight management. Most of the time I would start counting calories but then get bored or lost. But this app is a game changer, it’s not just another calorie tool but like having a support buddy by your side throughout the journey.

Seeing Capy grow as I make healthier choices was incredibly motivating. Capybara is my spiritual animal now😘 I wish I could visit a real one in life some day!
